body:
bloom_end_scene_and_composite() enabled GL_TEXTURE_2D for its own composite quads, bound to g_blur_tex_b (near-black bloom target), and never disabled it -- only GL_DEPTH_TEST got restored. The lobby's 2D menu draw never disables texturing itself, so every menu quad/string after returning from any 3D mode sampled that leftover dark texture and rendered black via GL_MODULATE. Fixed in bloom.c + defensively in setup_lobby_2d(). SHANKPIT 249930f.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed: bloom leaves GL_TEXTURE_2D on, blacking out the lobby menu after any mode
